svg.title: SuperCell composition
svg.desc: STRUCTURE ONLY / NOT ELECTRICAL NETS. One SuperCell contains eight mounting boards; each board passively gangs six SiPMs, yielding 48 SiPMs and one channel. Source: The DUNE Photon Detection System (Phase I), page 14.
